scope: Fresh private wheel/sdist builds and archive audit. Prior installed execution is reused only because the wheel bytes match exactly; no new installed tests or sponsor/GPU validation.

archive_integrity.scope: Source/assets/license/private-path integrity; not installed execution, secret scanning or sponsor validation

initial_failure.error: PyPI DNS failure resolving hatchling; no artifact produced
initial_failure.remediation: Offline populated cache; both subsequent builds passed

disclosure_scope: Configured local credential values and native runner key only; not comprehensive publication review.
limits: A source distribution is a runtime/development package, not the complete public repository or submission evidence bundle.
Build revision is pinned; later documentation edits require a newly frozen final archive.
Public package/repository publication, anonymous setup, remote CI and sponsor integrations remain unvalidated.
